eczema: Moisturise regularly, ideally right after bathing
Avoid harsh soaps and hot showers
Try to identify and avoid triggers such as irritants or allergens
See a doctor or dermatologist if it worsens, becomes painful, oozes, or disturbs sleep
psoriasis: See a dermatologist for evaluation; effective treatments exist
Seek care promptly if you have joint pain or stiffness alongside the skin changes
rosacea: Note and avoid personal triggers (for example sun, heat, alcohol, spicy food)
Use sun protection and gentle skincare
See a doctor or dermatologist for treatment options
Seek care if you have eye irritation or pain
acne vulgaris: Avoid squeezing pimples, which can cause scarring
See a doctor if acne is painful, deep, scarring, or not improving
